title: Open position at University of Oslo
subtitle: Doctoral Research Fellow in Cybersecurity with Focus on Identity and Access Management
summary: Our SEC research group at the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo is hiring a new (fully-funded) Ph.D. candidate to research in cybersecurity with a focus on Identity and Access Management. Become part of an engaged team of researchers and support us in investigating security, usability, and privacy of modern authentication technologies.
